title: Roll out feature flags across the platform
description: Platform-wide rollout of feature flags, informed by prior vendor and strategy research.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Introduce a feature-flag system across all platform services to enable controlled, incremental rollouts.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.body: Decouple deploy from release, support gradual rollouts, and provide a kill switch for risky changes.

tasks.text: Select feature-flag vendor based on research
Add SDK to shared platform library
Integrate flags into the web frontend
Integrate flags into the API services
Document flag lifecycle and cleanup process
